LanguageData.VaultAllowDepositDesc: When enabled, haulers may store items in this building (enabled by default).
LanguageData.VaultAllowWithdrawDesc: When enabled, haulers may automatically take items, and workbench ingredients and eating/treatment search see this building's contents (enabled by default).
LanguageData.VaultAllowTakeForUse: Allow taking for use while withdrawing is disallowed
LanguageData.VaultAllowTakeForUseDesc: When "Allow withdrawing" is off, enabling this keeps workbench ingredients and eating/treatment search visible (hauling remains disabled).
LanguageData.VaultFrozenDesc: When enabled, hides all items in this building and pauses its work (the storage filter is left unchanged, and items remain in the outerrealm storage). Disable to show them again.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_OpenDesc: View all contents of subspace (ignoring every terminal filter), and force-eject or transfer them to a chosen map.
LanguageData.SubspaceAccessManagerOpenDesc: Manage which pawns have subspace access (draw/deposit remotely).
LanguageData.SubspaceAccess_OpenManagerDesc: Open the subspace storage manager to eject items nearby.
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeLabel: Outerrealm vault right-click menu refresh mode
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeDesc: Controls how often the right-click menu is regenerated while open. Regenerating is expensive when the vault holds many item types; this reduces stutter.
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeLazyDesc: Menu content stays fixed while open; options are re-validated against the current game state when clicked. Best performance; ideal because vault menu content barely changes while open.
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModePeriodic: Frame-based: regenerate every N rendered frames
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModePeriodicDesc: Fully regenerates the menu every N rendered frames (default 60). Lower values keep the menu more up to date but each regeneration costs time when many items are stored.
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeAdaptive: Time-based: regenerate every N real seconds
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeAdaptiveDesc: Fully regenerates the menu every N real seconds (at least 4 frames apart), independent of framerate.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_VaultExcludeFromWealth: Outerrealm vault items do not count toward colony wealth
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_VaultExcludeFromWealthDesc: When enabled, items inside the vault do not count toward colony wealth (WealthItems) and do not contribute to raid points. Items already taken out or being hauled still count normally. Enabled by default.
LanguageData.VaultRightClickMenuModeDesc: Switches how the right-click menu looks when clicking THIS vault. Each vault is set independently and saved with the save file, so you can use the vanilla menu on some vaults and the large list on others. Vanilla: RimWorld's original menu. Large list: a big searchable list (supports pinyin) that pauses the game while open.
